name: url-tracker-lab
description: URL Tracker Lab - Test. Verify. Optimize. Internal testing and traffic simulation tool for URL trackers.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
